checkpoint._comment: Forge must be pointed at THIS revision, not the moving main URL.

conventions.forge_symbol: gelu (inside the transformer block, after m_gelu(l1))
conventions._comment: Traces are from ONE prefill pass over the full token sequence. No sampling, no KV-cache incremental decode, no generation.

tolerance._comment: Tolerance per case = max(envelope_multiplier * max|cpu_ref - cuda_ref|, abs_floor). If no second reference backend is available, the abs/rel floors are used alone and the report says so.

criteria._comment: min_margin_ratio: a destination decision only counts as testable when (top1 - top2) of the per-neuron maxima exceeds min_margin_ratio x tolerance. Cases below that are reported as INDETERMINATE, not as failures.
